title: Specialty Products and Insulation (SPI)
content:
Specialty Products and Insulation is one of the largest insulation and specialty building material distributors in North America. The company supports industrial and commercial buyers with stocked aerogel insulation products, branch-level fulfillment, and fabrication services.

  • Coverage Area: United States and Canada
  • Focus Areas: Industrial insulation, commercial insulation, residential insulation, marine insulation, refractory systems, fire protection, OEM fabrication, and aerogel blanket supply
  • Current Brands Represented: Aspen Aerogels (Pyrogel®, Cryogel®), Owens Corning, Rockwool, 3M, Armacell, and Johns Manville
  • Official Website: https://www.spi-co.com
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
